definitions.explanation: A male performer in film, television, or theater. Used mainly in formal contexts and award names where the distinction between male and female performers is relevant.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{人気|にんき}{男優|だんゆう}だ。
examples.english: He is a popular male actor.

examples.japanese: その{作品|さくひん}で{助演|じょえん}{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
examples.english: He won Best Supporting Actor for that work.

examples.japanese: アカデミー{賞|しょう}の{主演|しゅえん}{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}は、{映画|えいが}{業界|ぎょうかい}で{最|もっと}も{名誉|めいよ}ある{賞|しょう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: The Academy Award for Best Actor is one of the most prestigious awards in the film industry.

notes:
Compound of {男|だん} (male) + {優|ゆう} (actor; the final character of {俳優|はいゆう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主演|しゅえん}{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}: Best Actor award
- {助演|じょえん}{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}: Best Supporting Actor award
- {人気|にんき}{男優|だんゆう}: popular actor
- {若手|わかて}{男優|だんゆう}: young/up-and-coming actor

USAGE:
Less common in everyday speech than the gender-neutral {俳優|はいゆう} (actor) — most Japanese speakers refer to a male actor simply as {俳優|はいゆう}. {男優|だんゆう} is used mainly when the male/female distinction matters, such as in award titles or industry reporting.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俳優|はいゆう}: actor — gender-neutral, the default term
- {女優|じょゆう}: actress — the female counterpart, used more frequently than {男優|だんゆう}
- {役者|やくしゃ}: actor (especially in stage or traditional theater)
